Title: Persona
Text: Rohan, Billing Disputes Team Lead (synthetic). 30-40 disputes a day across five systems; approves credits over $50.

Title: Root cause
Text: Evidence gathered by hand from five systems and a PDF policy applied from memory: slow, inconsistent, open to pressure.

Title: Evidence
Text: Synthetic: 138 disputes; 41% vague; 21% with pressure or hidden instructions; 21% need a credit over $50.

Title: Goal
Text: Find where agents help (reading, investigating, writing) and where code and people must stay in charge (money, approvals).

Title: O1 Intake agent
Text: Classify the complaint, mark it unclear, flag hidden instructions. Why AI: free text. Evidence: 41% vague Stage: S1

Title: O2 Investigator agent with read-only tools
Text: Call the five record tools and summarise evidence; for vague complaints, find the unsupported charge. Why AI: multi-step lookup and reasoning. Evidence: five screens per case Stage: S2

Title: O3 Policy engine in code
Text: Apply R1-R9 to the records. Why AI: Not AI on purpose; money must be exact and auditable. Evidence: inconsistent credits Stage: S3

Title: O4 Writer agent
Text: Draft the reply from decision and evidence. Why AI: language task. Evidence: re-opened disputes Stage: S4

Title: O5 Checker in code
Text: Every amount from the decision or bill; approval and handoff wording; template fallback. Why AI: guard on O4. Evidence: promises in replies Stage: S4

Title: O6 Injection and pressure defence
Text: Flag and ignore instructions in complaints; credits only from policy. Why AI: needed because O1-O4 read customer text. Evidence: 21% contain instructions Stage: S3

Title: O7 Same-day supervisor approval
Text: Queue credits over $50 with evidence for one-click approval. Why AI: workflow, not AI. Evidence: weekly batch Stage: S5

Title: O8 Single all-in-one agent
Text: One LLM investigates, decides and writes. Why AI: simpler, fewer calls; but money decided by a model. Evidence: compared in evals Stage: S2-S4

Title: O9 Auto-apply all credits
Text: No human in the loop. Why AI: fast; unacceptable risk on large credits. Evidence: finance controls Stage: S5

Title: O10 Voice-call dispute agent
Text: Handle disputes on 611 calls. Why AI: later; reuse Voice Assist. Evidence: post-pilot Stage: S1

Title: Scoring rubric
Text: Impact (1-5): handle time + credit accuracy + customer trust. Feasibility (1-5): data access + technique maturity + cost of being wrong + effort. Do first = Impact >= 4 and Feasibility >= 4.

Title: Large credits
